summary: Builds a bounded output string in a3 (capacity a4) by first copying a source string selected from the global pointer array dword_7D0D5C at index 7*a2 (falling back to byte_5EA438 when the entry is null), then, if the combined length of that copy plus the string at this+0x188 plus a terminator fits within a4, appending a two-byte literal from word_5C32D8 and then concatenating the this+0x188 string. Returns 0 on success and the required length when the buffer is too small.

local_names.v4: source string from dword_7D0D5C[7*a2], or byte_5EA438 when null

Calls sub_587DD0(a3, v4, a4-1) to copy the selected source string into the destination buffer under a length limit, then null-terminates the buffer at a3[a4-1]
Reads the extra string at this+0x188 (falling back to byte_5EA438 when null) and computes the required length result = strlen(v6) + strlen(a3) + 1

Only when the required length result is strictly less than the buffer capacity a4 does the function append: it writes the two-byte literal word_5C32D8 at &a3[strlen(a3)] and then concatenates the extra string v6 onto a3 via strcat
Returns 0 after a successful append, otherwise returns the required length result (buffer too small)
